text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Christmas. Every year, a Christmas event 
is held at Funabashi Racecourse, and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help out with that, Furioso and I had 
returned to Funabashi Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Happy holidays! Welcome to Funabashi 
Racecourse, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The mascot character greeting area is over 
that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, Funabashi Racecourse has mascot 
characters of its own too. That's right...
choice_data_list:
When you think of Funabashi, you think of 
Funa...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You must not, Trainer. No further than 
that!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"While that mascot is famous, it isn't 
officially recognized by Funabashi City."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
From a rights perspective, we can't treat 
this lightly. Let's be sure to keep the 
boundaries clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso was really on the ball with this 
sort of thing. Of course, the official 
mascot of Funabashi Racecourse isn't that 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The meet-and-greet area is that way. The 
meet-and-greet is over that way...

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Big Sis Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, what can I do for you? If you're 
looking for the meet-and-greet, that's 
over there...

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Can I please take a picture of big sister 
Furioso?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh, not the mascot, but mine?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Of course I don't mind. Please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text: Thank you♪ Well then, here!

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text: Cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Furioso, could I get one over here too? 
I'd like to ask for a slightly cooler 
look, though.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Furioso, over here too. Give us a bright 
and cheerful vibe, please!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso turned toward the fans, stopped on 
a dime, and struck a picture-perfect pose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the fans thank them too. The 
conversation gets lively, but...
choice_data_list: Were you practicing poses or something?

Were you practicing your poses or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, not particularly. Though when asked, I 
just...
choice_data_list: ポーズの練習とかしてるのか？
ポーズの練習とかしてるの？
choice_data_list_en: Have you been practicing poses or something?
Are you practicing poses or something?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My body reacted in a flash on its own and 
pulled up at just the right position.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... it's not just talent. The 
reason she can adapt is probably her 
"sharp intellect."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her instantaneous analytical skills and 
braking power seemed to be put to good use 
in photography as well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thank you for your hard work today, 
Trainer. I'm just glad everyone enjoyed 
it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. We have free time after this, right? 
Since it's Christmas, maybe we should do 
something too..."
choice_data_list: ああ、かなり盛り上がったな！
うん、かなり盛り上がったね！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, everyone got so hyped up!
Yeah, that really hyped everyone up!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I don't really do anything 
special every year. If there's one thing I 
always do...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Just buying a slightly discounted whole 
cake right before closing time and eating 
it together. But...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's not bad, is it? Eating cake while 
sipping on coffee.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a tradition, after all.
Yeah, it is a tradition, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a custom from our days back at 
Funabashi Tracen. We'd share a Christmas 
cake together in the Trainer's Room and 
other places.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, it's a tradition, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even if it isn't flashy, sticking to our 
usual routine is best, right?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Where should we do it this year? The 
Trainer's office, my house, your room. 
Anywhere's fine with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, just like always, the two of them 
quietly spent a simple, unadorned 
Christmas together.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. We have free time after this, right? 
Since it's Christmas, maybe we should do 
something too..."
choice_data_list: I'd like to take pictures of Furioso, too.
I want to take pictures of Furioso, too.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Wait, you mean me? I don't mind, but...
choice_data_list: 俺もフリオーソの写真を撮りたいな
私もフリオーソの写真を撮りたいな
choice_data_list_en: I'd like to take a photo of Furioso too.
I'd love to take pictures of Furioso, too.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that lack any novelty, though? We 
see each other every day, after all.
choice_data_list: Still, since we have the chance...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. I'll be in your care, then.
choice_data_list: それでも、せっかくだから
choice_data_list_en: Still, since we have the chance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us decided to go ahead 
with the photoshoot, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
T-This is troubling... I don't know what 
kind of pose would make them happy.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always showing all kinds of different 
faces. Do you have a request, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Being told to take the lead makes me even 
more... Well then, let me think about this 
in my own way..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, something like this is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me. What an embarrassing 
blunder...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I know it doesn't suit me, but even so, 
when it comes to rare items..."
choice_data_list:
Ah, the way you did it just now might be 
good.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh, this expression...?
choice_data_list: あ、今の感じがいいかも
choice_data_list_en: Oh, what you just did might be good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I felt like seeing Furioso get flustered 
like this was a rare sight."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Well then... yes, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, normally I can stop on a dime, but... 
I hesitated for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please don't let anyone else see 
that photo. It's quite embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a Christmas souvenir, I 
received a rare photo of Furioso.
